children: CBOT December corn (CZ26) may fall toward its September 18 low of $5.25-1/2 per bushel, driven by a wave c.
A correction from the September 2 high of $5.49-3/4 looks incomplete, as suggested by the successive drops over the past two trading sessions.
A projection analysis on the wave c marks a target of $5.28-1/4, the 61.8% level. A retracement analysis on the uptrend from $5.25-1/2 reveals a break below the 61.8% level of $5.32-1/2.
The break increases the chance of the market to revisit the low of $5.25-1/2.
